message.content:
Tersely: A roughly shield/heraldic-shaped object with angular, faceted silhouette; dark matte gray (charcoal), no gloss; surfaces show embossed cross-like outlines that repeat and mirror awkwardly. Geometry problems: two mirrored halves misaligned with a visible seam at top center, duplicated cross shapes (four instead of one), and jagged spike-like protrusions along the bottom edge.

Fidelity: 0.15 — it resembles a shield shape but is dark matte gray with duplicated, malformed cross outlines rather than a glossy blue-violet surface with a single clean white cross.
